text: A video shows French President Emmanuel Macron, United Kingdom Prime Minister Keir Starmer, and German Chancellor Freidrich Merz with a bag of cocaine after visiting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
text_translated: A video shows French President Emmanuel Macron, United Kingdom Prime Minister Keir Starmer, and German Chancellor Freidrich Merz with a bag of cocaine after visiting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

text: FALSE!    Video does not show Macron or Merz hiding cocaine.    Higher resolution video and photo show that the "cocaine bag" is a handkerchief / tissue paper, and the "cocaine spoon" is a cocktail skewer.
